mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates an accommodative monetary policy, which reduces the cost of capital and increases equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 3.5% (the 5-year median), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.0% signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is above 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and CPIAUCSL exceeds 330, the interaction between monetary policy tightening and high inflation signals a monetary tightening cycle, which increases equity risk premiums and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 330, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong demand for housing and related sectors, which is a leading indicator for overall economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates strong economic activity and supply chain resilience, which is associated with positive equity returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO is above its 12-month moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A labor market unemployment rate below 4.0% indicates tight labor conditions, which signals strong economic growth and positive equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1500 (HOUST) indicates strong demand for housing and related sectors, which is a leading indicator for overall economic demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 60% of instances when HOUST is above 1500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) exceeds 100 and employment (PAYEMS) exceeds 150000, the interaction between supply chain strength and labor market conditions signals a robust economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances when INDPRO > 100 and PAYEMS > 150000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
